findings.text: The document says the resolver produces the out-of-width index, but `KeysUniqueExamples.lean` constructs it directly and tests `runStatement`. Fix: attribute the counterexample to execution of manually constructed resolved statements.

The required resolver fact is false for an empty index term list: `resolveCreateIndex` accepts it, but `CatalogIndex.supported` rejects it. Fix: record this counterexample and qualify the proposed theorem with an explicit syntax precondition.

The proposed assumptions require catalog validity but omit initial row width, so the existing `shortRows` counterexample still prevents removing the ADD COLUMN hypothesis. Fix: require `Database.Admitted` for the initial database and any transaction snapshot when stating the slice 4 theorem.
